$comment: The single source of truth for which kernel this shell bundles. Upstream is a developer preview that documents breaking changes between releases, so upgrading is an explicit commit — never something a rebuild does on its own. Do not repeat these values anywhere else; a second copy stays self-consistent right up until someone changes only one of them.

nodeRuntime.$comment: The kernel is bundled with the Node build it is published against, rather than being run on Electron's built-in Node. Those are different runtimes: the kernel's HMR plugin aborts startup under Electron-as-Node with '--expose-internals is required', and starts cleanly on this build with the same configuration. sha256 is the value published in https://nodejs.org/dist/<version>/SHASUMS256.txt.

shippedPlugins.$comment: Plugins installed into resources/kernel/node_modules/ at build time and registered into the user's profile on first launch. The kernel resolves bundles from either the install anchor (this directory) or the profile's node_modules, so the bundled copy is reachable from any user. integrity is the npm sha512 — install-kernel.js verifies it against package-lock.json, same as the kernel entry.
